about: The one move table: 5 channels by 3 satisfaction states, and the 15 moves that step between those cells. Copies live in bars-engine (src/lib/quest-grammar/move-table.json) and sprout (data/move-table.json); tests/test_move_table.py fails when a copy differs. Built 2026-10-19 from Wendell's board answers (ledger council/ledger/2026-10-19-pull-225647.json).

rulings.mn-q-what-move-is: both: the cells are the engine (layer 1); actions owned by faces and daemons are named skins, each mapping to exactly one of the fifteen moves (layer 2).
rulings.mn-q-face-daemon: own: each face and daemon owns its moves. Daemons have habits and their own moves, and no home channel.
rulings.mn-q-ke-state: depends: what a control move does to satisfaction depends on the starting state (families.control.state).
rulings.mn-transcend-plus-two: overruled: Transcend is two separate steps, dissatisfied to neutral, then neutral to satisfied.
rulings.mn-gold-names: stands: Metal's satisfied name is Wonder-Excitement; Earth's channel is Neutrality, never Neutral.
rulings.mn-basic-moves-apart: stands: the five Basic Moves (Wake, Open, Clean, Grow, Show) are not in this table.

transcend.note: Two steps in one channel. From satisfied there is no transcend step (null: not offered).

generative.note: Carries the charge to the channel sheng feeds and raises it one state; satisfied is the ceiling.

control.note: Depends on where you start: from satisfied it holds, from neutral it pulls back, from dissatisfied it holds. Never raises; acts by releasing grip (ea13b-ke-release).

owners.about: Layer 2. Each face and daemon owns its moves; an owned action always names one move id above. Faces are seeded from bars-engine lens-moves.ts. Daemons own moves too, with no home channel; their lists are not written yet.

checks.why: Pass move-nature1 Tests: one charge through Anger dissatisfied and Temper Action ends in one cell on every surface.
